title: scrophularia aquatica f. lyrata
intro: Scrophularia aquatica f. lyrata, commonly known as Marsh Figwort, is a plant species belonging to the family Scrophulariaceae. This herb is valued for its potential health benefits, which include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Figwort include soothing and protecting the skin, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
